class.name: NetwPredictVerdict
class.brief_description: One receive-side judgement of a predicted transition, either a state comparison or an acknowledgement, never both.
class.description: Wraps whichever of two judgements produced it: a state comparison, made when a fresh authoritative state row arrives, or an acknowledgement, made when authority's ack of a locally predicted transition arrives. The two share every accessor, but a member that only means something for one kind answers a fixed default under the other rather than being unavailable. [method recv_tick], [method corrected], [method settled], [method divergence], and [method field_errors] are state-only and answer [code]-1[/code], [code]false[/code], [code]false[/code], [code]0.0[/code], and an empty array on an acknowledgement verdict. [method domain] and [method differing_family] are the mirror case: an acknowledgement always reads [code]OUT_OF_DOMAIN[/code] and [code]NONE[/code], since only a state comparison narrows either. [br][br][method exact] holds for both kinds: [code]0[/code] means the row was never comparable at all, [code]1[/code] means it matched exactly, and [code]2[/code] means it did not.

method.name: attribution
method.description: The [enum NetwPredictJournal.Attribution] this verdict assigns to its divergence, or [constant NetwPredictJournal.UNKNOWN] when it judged none.

method.name: compared
method.description: Whether this verdict actually ran a comparison, as opposed to a row that arrived with nothing yet to compare it against.

method.name: corrected
method.description: Whether a state comparison's divergence was corrected in the same pass that judged it. Always [code]false[/code] on an acknowledgement verdict, which never applies a correction of its own.

method.name: differing_family
method.description: Which state family an acknowledgement narrowed its divergence to: [code]0[/code] none, [code]1[/code] pose, [code]2[/code] momentum, or [code]3[/code] the controller latch. Always [code]0[/code] on a state comparison verdict, which judges the whole state rather than one family.

method.name: divergence
method.description: The magnitude of a state comparison's divergence, or [code]0.0[/code] on an acknowledgement verdict.

method.name: domain
method.description: The [enum NetwPredictJournal.Domain] a state comparison judged its divergence to be in. Always [constant NetwPredictJournal.OUT_OF_DOMAIN] on an acknowledgement verdict, which carries no domain classification of its own.

method.name: evidence_complete
method.description: Whether an acknowledgement's evidence covered every field it needed to judge. Always [code]false[/code] on a state comparison verdict.

method.name: exact
method.description: Whether this row matched exactly: [code]0[/code] never judged, [code]1[/code] equal, or [code]2[/code] unequal. Meaningful for both a state comparison and an acknowledgement verdict.

method.name: field_errors
method.description: One error magnitude per declared field, in declaration order, for a state comparison verdict. Empty on an acknowledgement verdict.

method.name: meter
method.description: The divergence meter a state comparison measured, the same scale [method NetwPredictEpisodeReport.comparison_meter] reads back from a recorded episode. [code]0[/code] on an acknowledgement verdict.

method.name: recv_tick
method.description: The local tick a state comparison's authoritative row arrived on, or [code]-1[/code] on an acknowledgement verdict.

method.name: settled
method.description: Whether a state comparison reached a final answer this pass: the transition was out of domain, or [method exact] judged it rather than leaving it [code]UNJUDGED[/code]. Always [code]false[/code] on an acknowledgement verdict.

method.name: transition
method.description: The transition this verdict judges, read from whichever of the state comparison or the acknowledgement produced it.
